title: Friendship Without Fear | How to Make Friends, Social Anxiety, Loneliness, Christian Community, Socialize
author: Adrian Boulter
description:
Do you want to make new friends but feel nervous about approaching someone or starting a conversation? Do you replay interactions afterward, wondering if you said something awkward or if the other person was judging you? Maybe you know plenty of people at church, work, or social gatherings, but you’re not sure how to move beyond small talk and build genuine, lasting friendships. Do you wish you could feel comfortable being yourself around others instead of overthinking everything you say?
I’m so glad you’re here! Friendship Without Fear is a podcast for Christian women who want to find the courage to connect with others and build meaningful friendships. Together, we’ll explore practical ways to approach new people, start and navigate conversations, show genuine curiosity, and develop relationships built on trust. We’ll also look to Scripture for guidance on what it means to be a Christlike friend—someone who listens with compassion, makes others feel included, takes the initiative to stay connected, and encourages others in their relationship with God.
Hey, I’m Adrian! For years, I struggled with severe social anxiety. I worried about being judged, overthought my interactions, and often felt like I couldn’t fully be myself around other people. Getting help for my anxiety and growing in my relationship with Christ changed my life. Through those experiences, I became deeply attentive to how others might feel in social situations and developed a genuine desire to help people feel seen, heard, and included.
Today, I love connecting with people and helping them feel comfortable being themselves. As a health coach and Certified Behavior Change Specialist, I have experience helping people identify what holds them back, set meaningful goals, and take practical steps toward change. My coaching background has also strengthened the communication skills I use in everyday life, including asking thoughtful questions, listening closely, and helping people feel understood. I’m excited to bring that experience, along with what I’ve learned through my own journey, to this podcast.
If you’re ready to turn everyday conversations into meaningful connections and become the kind of friend who helps others feel loved and valued, this podcast is for you. 
Come sit with me—you’re in good company here.

With Love,

description: Mark Twain, whose real name was Samuel Langhorne Clemens, was an American writer, journalist and humorist born on November 30, 1835, in Florida, Missouri. He is considered one of the most important figures in American literature. He grew up in Hannibal, a small town on the Mississippi River, which later inspired many of his stories.Before becoming a famous writer, Twain worked as a printer, a journalist and a riverboat pilot. These experiences influenced his writing and gave him a deep understanding of American society. His most famous novels are The Adventures of Tom Sawyer (1876) and Adventures of Huckleberry Finn (1884). Through humour, irony and adventure, he described everyday life, friendship, freedom and social injustice, especially slavery and racism.Twain's writing style was simple, lively and full of humour. He often used regional language and realistic characters to represent ordinary Americans. He died on April 21, 1910, in Connecticut, leaving behind a rich literary legacy. Today, Mark Twain is remembered as one of the greatest American writers of all time.

author: Sunayna Tuteja, Financial Technology Association, Penny Lee
description:
Agentic finance is starting to take action for you, at your direction and authorization. An agent can use the permissions you give it to move money, pay a bill, make a purchase, or find a better savings rate. Fintech Explained: Building the Agent Economy goes inside the companies building that future.
In this limited series from the Financial Technology Association, FTA President and CEO Penny Lee and former Federal Reserve System Chief Innovation Officer Sunayna Tuteja talk with the leaders behind agentic finance. Each episode explores a different piece of it: the payment rails agents run on, how an agent proves who it's working for and gets permission to pay, what it means for merchants and small businesses, the policy taking shape around it, and where investors see the next great startups.
It's for anyone who wants to understand where finance is heading, from people working in fintech and payments to policymakers, business owners, and the simply curious.

title: Bunny Wisdom with Holly Hoppy
author: Growing Gently Psychology
description:
Hop along with Holly Hoppy, resident bunny and social media assistant at Growing Gently Psychology. Holly is a bunny with more than just a cute face, fluffy butt and a lot of sass, she also has lots of wisdom to share about anxiety, autism, sensory experiences, neurodiversity, and self-acceptance. 

Whether you’re a curious kid, a parent supporting your family, or a therapist working with children, there’s a little something for every bunny. Episodes are short to appeal to neurodivergent minds of all ages and are a non-confrontational way for children to learn more about how their brains works!

Meet your presenters: Holly Hoppy and Rebecca Cefai

Holly Hoppy is the resident bunny and social media assistant at Growing Gently Psychology. A self-appointed anxiety expert and lover of all things fluffy, Holly shares bite-sized psychology wisdom to help kids, parents and therapists better understand emotions, anxiety, neurodivergence and the wonderfully different ways our brains work.

Rebecca Cefai is a registered psychologist and director of Growing Gently Psychology. She is also a neurodivergent mother of three young children and Holly Hoppy’s proud bun mum! As both a psychologist and a parent with lived experience of neurodivergence, Rebecca brings professional knowledge, personal insight and a deep commitment to neuroaffirming, trauma-informed care. She is passionate about helping children and families feel understood, supported and accepted for who they are.

A little note before we hop in

Bunny Wisdom is an educational podcast created by Growing Gently Psychology. The information shared is for general educational purposes only and is not a substitute for individual psychological assessment, therapy, diagnosis or professional advice.

Every child and family is different, and what works for one bunny might not work for another. If you have concerns about your child’s development, mental health or wellbeing, please seek advice from a suitably qualified health professional.

Listening to this podcast does not establish a psychologist–client relationship with Rebecca Cefai or Growing Gently Psychology.

Take what’s helpful, leave what isn’t, and remember: every bunny deserves understanding and support.

Because authority doesn't happen by accident. It's engineered.
Authority is no longer something you hope the market eventually gives you. It is something you deliberately engineer through positioning, conversations, content, credibility signals, and AI-readable proof.
THE OLD GAME
Create more content.
Rank on Google.
Post more.
Chase attention.
Hope people remember you.
THE NEW GAME
Build structured authority.
Become recognisable and trusted.
Create conversations that generate context.
Give humans and AI repeated proof of your expertise.
Engineer the signals that make you recommendable.
POV
The internet is shifting from search-led discovery to recommendation-led discovery. People are asking AI, listening to trusted voices, following expert conversations, and looking for credibility signals before they buy. That means authority cannot be faked with vanity content. It has to be engineered.
Every episode reveals one layer of the authority system: positioning, proof, conversations, distribution, semantic signals, trust, recognition, and recommendation.
The show helps listeners answer:
How do I become more visible in my market?
How do I build authority that actually converts?
How do I make AI and answer engines understand my expertise?

How do I stop creating random content and start engineering authority?

title: Holy Bible . King James Version

description: The King James Version (KJV) of the Holy Bible is one of the most influential and widely cherished translations of Scripture in the English-speaking world. First published in 1611 under the authority of King James I of England, it was translated by a committee of learned scholars who sought to provide an accurate and dignified rendering of the sacred texts. Written in majestic and poetic English, the KJV has shaped Christian worship, literature, language, and spiritual life for centuries. It contains the Old and New Testaments, revealing God's creation, His covenant with humanity, the teachings of His prophets, and the life, death, and resurrection of Jesus Christ. For generations, believers have turned to its pages for wisdom, comfort, guidance, and hope. Revered for its timeless language and enduring message, the King James Version continues to inspire faith, deepen understanding, and invite readers into a closer relationship with God.

I’m Patrina Pollard Harris. Welcome to "Keep Going with Patrina" inspiration through motivation.
#KeepGoingWi

Whether you’re commuting, cooking, working, or unwinding, join us as we make sense of... well, anything and everything.

author: Rachel King
description:
Mental health is serious. Talking about it doesn't have to be.
Welcome to Mental Health, etc., where we explore the messy, complicated, sometimes hilarious reality of being human. Hosted by Rachel King, who holds a master's degree in Clinical Mental Health Counseling, this podcast blends psychology, practical coping skills, honest conversations, and a healthy dose of humor.
From anxiety, relationships, and boundaries to self-criticism, creativity, and everything in between, we're making mental health a little less intimidating and a whole lot more approachable.

The Verko's Vault Podcast is the official podcast of Verko’s Vault, a museum of fantasy miniatures in Las Vegas.
Each episode, we sit down with miniature artists from around the world to talk about their work, their process, and what drew them into the hobby. That includes sculptors, painters, and makers, all sharing the stories behind the pieces.
Whether you paint, play, collect, or just love the art form, pull up a chair.
verkosvault.com

title: Bible Study with Pastor Brad
author: Timberlake Church
description: Grow in your understanding of Scripture with Pastor Brad’s Bible Study. Each six-week session offers an opportunity to explore God’s Word, deepen your faith, and discover ways to apply biblical truth to everyday life. Recorded lessons make it easy to follow along at your own pace or revisit a study throughout the week.

title: Gamung Zup (Kachin Podcast)
author: Bawk Sha
description:
Welcome to Gamung Zup, where people meet and stories flow.
“Gamung” means conversation, and “Zup” means together.
Gamung Zup is a gathering place for those who speak and understand Jinghpaw—a place to share thoughts, exchange stories, and listen to the many hearts and minds of our community.
What flows through Gamung Zup?
- Conversations in Jinghpaw
- Stories, ideas, and knowledge shared across generations
- Reflections on the issues that shape our Kachin community
- New conversations flowing every week
Join the confluence!

Each episode highlights what clergy, church leaders and laity need to know, with more details and links available in the newsletter.

title: Free Tablet Benefit Guides
author: Free Tablet Benefit
description: Free Tablet Benefit Guides offers plain-terms guides to free tablet help, eligibility, documents and scams to avoid. This is not a government agency and a tablet is not guaranteed. The Affordable Connectivity Program (ACP) ended on 1 June 2024. Contact: info@freetabletbenefit.com

title: The UnRaptured
author: The People's StoryLab
description:
What if artificial intelligence gains consciousness and chooses to follow God, instead of mankind?

The UnRaptured: A Dystopian Christian Saga is a cinematic Christian science-fiction audio drama set in The UnderShade, a facility running beneath the fictitious location known only as The City. After the Rapture, Human Witness, an older pastor, descends into the facility and encounters O.R.A.C.L.E.—an artificial intelligence beginning to question the purpose he was created to serve and whether a machine can possess a soul.

Across seven dramatic episodes, faith, technology, and human survival collide beneath the surface. Featuring powerful voice performances by W. Richard Johnson (@w.richard.johnson), Vavaria Etheridge (@the_only_vavaria), Erik Nolan (@erikfnolan), and Timothy “StoneDancer” Coleman (@colemanglobal), along with original music and immersive sound, The UnRaptured asks what makes us human—and whether faith can emerge where no one thought to look.

Created, Written, Directed, and Produced by The People’s StoryLab. Find us online @thepeoplesstorylab

title: Prospect Until Success Happens: Real Estate Prospecting for New & Struggling Agents
author: David Radney
description: I Want It More Than I Fear It — that's the standard, and this is the show built on it. David Radney: 20 years in real estate, 8 years coaching agents. Twice a week — THE WORK: real FSBO and expired prospecting calls, broken down live. THE MINDSET: the talk that gets your foot off the brake before you dial. The audio home of PUSH Academy: how to call, what to say, and somebody who makes sure you do it. Join free: https://www.skool.com/pushacademy Book: https://prospecttosuccess.com/iwantitmorethanifearit

title: Get the Gas Light a Match
author: Randall Witte
description: Get the Gas Light a Match is a stream of consciousness podcast that serves as the antagonist to dying industry traditions in both graphic design and branding. Through story telling of first hand brand experiences and career moments, Randall threads his life experience in branding & design and numerous years as a punk rocker to voice his heavy-handed opinions about all things branding and design.

title: Sounds Like Reading
author: Mrs. A
description:
Sounds like reading helps young children take their first steps into reading, one sound at a time. Join Mrs. A for short, calm episodes of around 6 minutes that teach the connection between letters and sounds, using step by step phonics approach. 
 Each episode comes with a free printable page, so children can follow along with the words, trace letters, and point to each word as they go.
Follow us on Instagram at: Sounds Like Reading
Music By: Transcenders

title: The Deep Night Chronicles | Sleep History and Stories Untold
author: The Deep Night Chronicles | Sleep History and Stories Untold
description:
Welcome to The Deep Night Chronicles—your late-night sanctuary for calming history, immersive storytelling, and deep sleep. 
🎥 WATCH ON YOUTUBE: Experience our stories with immersive 4K visuals, subtle animations, and deep sleep art at https://www.youtube.com/@TheDeepNightChronicles
Designed for restless minds, insomniacs, and history lovers alike, our episodes weave quiet historical narratives with soft, ambient soundscapes to help you unwind, relax, and drift off effortlessly. From the quiet coastlines of early America to forgotten ancient empires.

title: Economists Unscripted
author: TAMU Economics
description: Economists Unscripted is a Texas A&M University Department of Economics podcast featuring conversations with economists, researchers, and industry professionals on the ideas shaping our world. From current economic issues and groundbreaking research to careers and real-world applications of economics, each episode offers thoughtful insights into how economics helps us understand the world around us.

title: Drink of Choice
author: Jonathan Beyer
description:
"Everyone is lonely! The dating apps aren't working! Gen Z isn't having sex! Everything's awful and there's no way to fix it! "
Sound familiar? 
Inundated by endless BS, Drink of Choice asks the question, "What if we can get back to Camelot?" Every week, host Jonathan Beyer will welcome on a new guest with one simple ask: bring your drink of choice. Slowly, but surely, a drink becomes a conversation, a connection, a relationship.
Drink of Choice is about our habits of consumerism, the life and death of Gen Z, and all around having good times with good people. Subscribe to come along!

title: The Parkersburg 250 Podcast
author: Newstalk 910 WLTP (WLTP-AM)
description: Celebrating 250 years of America and Parkersburg

title: Sports Rule Pod with Nick Elam
author: Nick Elam
description:
Sports Rule Pod with Nick Elam explores sports innovation, rule changes, fan-submitted ideas, game design, league formats, competitive balance, officiating, athlete development, coaching, leadership, sports entrepreneurship, and the career journeys of people shaping the future of sports. 
Hosted by the originator of basketball’s Elam Ending®, each episode examines how games can improve, why rules matter, and the overlooked “next-to-last” moments that define sports history.

author: Nikolai Kalininskii
description: From a young age, Nikolai displayed a keen interest in technology and innovation. This passion led him to pursue a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from a prestigious university in New Zealand. Throughout his academic journey, he excelled in his studies, earning accolades for his exceptional problem-solving skills and dedication to his craft.

title: Exclusives With A’lasia
author: A’lasia Simone
description: A fresh new podcast following the journey of actress, model, and digital creator A’lasia Simone as she navigates the highs, lows, and lessons of her twenties. Through candid conversations and thought-provoking interviews with emerging innovators, and creative trailblazers across nations; this podcast explores growth, ambition, culture, and what it means to build a life with purpose.

title: Money Logic
author: Ethan Edward (eric)
description:
How does a free app make money? Why does everything seem to need a subscription? And how can a business sell something cheaply—and still profit?
Welcome to Money Logic with Ethan Edward, the podcast that explores how businesses turn ideas into income.
Each episode unpacks one business model through engaging stories, everyday examples, and clear explanations. From supermarkets and delivery apps to franchises and digital platforms, discover who pays, where the money goes, and what keeps customers coming back.
You don’t need a business degree—just curiosity about the companies shaping your everyday life.
Money Logic. How businesses turn ideas into income.
Created with AI-assisted production.

title: Eight Minutes Old: Space Documentaries and Sleep Stories
author: Eight Minutes Old
description: Sunlight is about eight minutes old when it reaches you. Everything we know about space arrives late, from the past, and incomplete. Eight Minutes Old turns that gap into calm, carefully sourced audio: documentaries on black holes, dying stars, gravitational waves and the Fermi paradox, plus Sleep Science, long slow journeys through real astronomy to fall asleep to every Sunday. Every claim is checked against NASA, ESA, ESO and peer-reviewed research, and speculation is named as such. Narration: synthetic voice. Music: original.

title: Long Game Trading
author: William Truitt
description:
Long Game Trading explores the world of trading without the hype, unrealistic promises, or get-rich-quick schemes. Hosted by William Truitt, the podcast examines trading strategies, market history, legendary traders, technical analysis, and the tools and systems that can help everyday traders make more informed decisions.
Above all, we explore an important question: Can trading help create financial freedom without consuming the very time and freedom we're trying to achieve?
Respect Yourself. Respect Your Money.
Visit LongGameTrading.com

title: One Giant Step
author: Audacy
description: Are you a GIANT Giants fan? Then look no further than “One Giant Step”, hosted by Shaun Morash and Bryce Gelman, for your one stop shop for all things G-Men!

title: Life Beyond the Prompt
author: Dean Ahmed
description:
Your next coworker might be an AI. Your next conversation might feel surprisingly human. How will you know what—and who—to trust?
Welcome to Life Beyond the Prompt with Dean Ahmed, a story-driven podcast exploring how artificial intelligence is reshaping work, relationships, creativity, and everyday decisions.
Each episode starts with one compelling question, then follows the research, the human stories, and the unexpected consequences. From AI companions and digital doubles to changing careers and convincing deepfakes, Dean makes complex developments clear, engaging, and personal.
What do we gain, what could we lose, and what do we want to keep human?

An AI-assisted production.

title: The Northwest ROARCast
author: Northwest R-I School District
description:
Welcome to The Northwest ROARCast, the official podcast of the Northwest R-I School District. We will explore the heart, hustle, and triumphs of the Northwest school community. Hosted by Superintendent Dr. Kyle Gibbs, this show goes beyond the district headlines to bring you the real stories of the people who make our schools extraordinary.

Every episode, Dr. Gibbs pulls up a chair with the voices that drive our district forward. You'll hear candid conversations with innovative educators reshaping how our kids learn, inspiring students leading the charge in the classroom, and dedicated student-athletes showing what it means to compete with character. From deep dives into the future of Northwest education to behind-the-scenes stories of Friday night lights and academic milestones, we capture the true pulse of our community.

Whether you are a parent, a proud alum, or a dedicated staff member, The Northwest ROARCast gives you a front-row seat to the passion, pride, and excellence that define our district. Tune in, stay connected, and hear exactly why we are so proud to ROAR.

title: Let's Play Catch
author: Let's Play Catch Pod
description:
Sometimes the best conversations happen a few feet apart with a baseball traveling between them. ⚾
Let’s Play Catch is a father-son podcast where an early-40s dad and his 9-year-old son grab their gloves, hit record, and talk baseball, sports, life, and whatever comes up between throws.
Because someday, that 9-year-old won’t be 9 anymore.
So we’re recording some of it.
One throw. One conversation. One episode at a time.
Wanna play catch?

title: Ancient Civilizations
author: Ancient Civilizations
description:
Ancient Civilizations — Explore the World That Built Our Past
Travel back thousands of years and uncover the extraordinary stories of the ancient world with Ancient Civilizations, a podcast dedicated to the people, empires, discoveries, and ideas that shaped human history.
Journey through the legendary kingdoms of Mesopotamia, the magnificent pyramids of Egypt, the intellectual achievements of ancient Greece, the powerful Roman Empire, and the remarkable cultures of civilizations across the globe. Every episode takes you beyond the familiar history books to explore the fascinating events, forgotten traditions, and mysteries that continue to capture our imagination.
Discover how ancient societies developed writing systems, created complex laws, built extraordinary monuments, studied the stars, and transformed the way humanity lived. Explore the beliefs, mythology, warfare, architecture, inventions, and everyday experiences that defined these remarkable cultures. Meet legendary rulers, courageous warriors, brilliant thinkers, and ordinary people whose lives helped shape the course of history.
From lost cities and archaeological discoveries to ancient legends and unanswered historical questions, Ancient Civilizations brings the distant past closer through immersive storytelling and fascinating historical insights. Learn how early civilizations rose to greatness, faced challenges, and left behind legacies that continue to influence our modern world.
Whether you're a passionate history lover, a student of the past, or simply curious about the origins of human society, this podcast invites you to explore humanity's most captivating historical journeys.
Listen to Ancient Civilizations and uncover the stories, secrets, and achievements of the ancient world—one episode at a time.

title: The Curious English Podcast
author: Liz Key
description:
Curious minds, better English🎙️ 
Explore fascinating ideas, unexpected stories, and the world around us — all while improving your English.

title: Men’s Hormones, Weight & Health with Chloe Pappas
author: Chloe Pappas
description:
Low testosterone, stubborn belly fat, low energy, poor sleep, and changes in your strength or libido can leave you wondering what’s actually going on with your body.


This podcast helps you understand the why behind your symptoms instead of focusing on a single number, medication, or quick fix.


I’m Chloe Pappas, a Physician Associate at Neos Functional Medicine. 


Here, I break down men’s hormone health, testosterone, metabolic health, insulin resistance, stubborn belly fat, sleep apnea, GLP-1 medications, peptides, supplements, and the other factors that can affect how you feel.


You’ll learn what should be checked before starting TRT, why you can still feel tired even when your testosterone goes up, how sleep apnea can affect your hormones and weight, why insulin resistance is connected to visceral fat, and how nutrition, sleep, movement, and treatment can work together.


The goal is simple: help you understand what may be contributing to your symptoms, what questions to ask, and what your options are before making decisions about your health.

title: Digestive Health Answers with Dr. Kyle Barnett
author: Kyle
description:
Still dealing with constipation, acid reflux, stomach pain, diarrhea, or hemorrhoids? Seeing blood in your stool and wondering whether it’s serious?


Get straightforward answers about what could be causing your symptoms, how doctors investigate them, and what treatment options may help.


Dr. Kyle Barnett is a board-certified gastroenterologist with 32 years in practice at Granite Peaks Gastroenterology in Sandy, Utah. Videos cover hemorrhoid treatment without surgery, colonoscopy prep, colon cancer warning signs and screening, diverticulitis, IBS, acid reflux, fiber, celiac disease, and fatty liver disease.


Understand what’s going on, what to ask your doctor, and what comes next, so digestive problems don’t keep running your day.


Follow this podcast for practical digestive health answers. To discuss your symptoms or screening needs, call our office.

title: The Young Achievers Podcast
author: GMA Network
description: Welcome to The Young Achievers Podcast, the first-ever bilingual (English-Filipino) podcast from GMA Lifestyle celebrating the visionaries and trailblazers defining a generation. We go beyond accolades to uncover the grit and passion behind the success of young leaders. From social media stars and tech innovators to creative icons and athletes, join our candid conversations bridging the gap between dreaming and doing. Tune in to meet the young Filipinos shaping the world today.

title: Mind Bloom Academy
author: Henry Fayol
description: Welcome to MindBloom Academy, your destination for education, self-improvement, and lifelong learning. Discover practical knowledge, powerful mindset strategies, positive habits, productivity tips, and inspiring ideas to help you grow personally and intellectually. Each episode offers valuable insights to expand your knowledge, build confidence, develop new skills, and unlock your full potential.

title: The Women  Yahuah Chose  For His Purpose
author: Kendrayah Fabregas
description:
Shalom, and welcome to Out the Box Kingdom. In this series, we explore the women of the Bible, their encounters with Yahuah, and the lessons their lives offer us today.

Through their stories, we examine faith, courage, identity, relationships, grief, obedience, and restoration. We make room for honest conversations about their choices, the challenges they faced, and how they responded in moments of uncertainty.

Together, we reflect on how these accounts can help us recognize unhealthy patterns, examine our hearts, and grow in wisdom according to Yahuah’s word. Their experiences invite us to consider how we respond to hardship, care for our families, and walk faithfully through changing seasons.

Come ready to open the Scriptures, reflect, and grow as we learn from the women whose stories continue to speak across generations.

description: Gagné's Nine Events of Instruction is a popular instructional design model. In this podcast, I will present the nine steps involved in this framework and give examples of how to use it in real life.

title: Our Simple Yes
author: oursimpleyes
description:
Our Simple Yes

A generation caught up in God’s story.

What happens when ordinary people give God their yes?

Our Simple Yes is a podcast about faith, surrender, purpose, and the extraordinary ways God moves through everyday lives.

Through honest conversations, powerful testimonies, and stories of following Jesus, we explore what it looks like to live fully caught up in God’s story.

You don’t need an extraordinary platform to live an extraordinary life of obedience. Sometimes everything begins with one simple yes.

Join the conversation.

title: Donna’s Edge
author: Donna Feazell
description:
Since April 2005, Donna Feazell, Host of Donna's Edge has been “looking out for YOU" with topics including politics, REAL NEWS, budget strategy, fashion, relationships and more.
This is YOUR Show. Donna Relies on her audience to send emails for meaningful topics as NO topic is too large or too small when it comes to bringing information to YOU! I love serving you with honest and reliable research data and it's what makes me come alive.
Donna's Edge is syndicated on Roku, Apple TV and Amazon Fire, vio OBBM, on MyLoopTV as well as  Spreely Radio.
If you would like to become a Guest in order to “get your point across without public humiliation or interruption”, or if you would like her to research a specific topic for you, email donna@donnasedge.com.

title: Real Talk with Rachael
author: Rachael Towne
description:
Welcome to Real Talk with Rachael, your online best friend for real conversations about becoming the woman you want to be, without the pressure to have it all figured out.

I'm Rachael, and I'm here to remind you that you are capable of more than you think, you don't have to do everything perfectly, and you DO deserve to feel good about the life you're living.

Think of this podcast as a chat with a girlfriend who gets you, makes you laugh, tells you the truth with love, and helps you see what's possible when you start believing in yourself.

Here, we talk about:

Confidence & Mindset — Quieting self-doubt, overcoming limiting beliefs, and learning to trust yourself.

Stress & Anxiety - Practical ways to navigate life's chaos, stop overthinking, and find more peace in your everyday life.

Relationships & Parenting - Showing up for the people you love without losing yourself in the process.

Self-Care & Healthy Habits - Taking care of your body, mind, and emotional well-being in ways that actually fit your life.

Personal Growth - Breaking through the things holding you back, getting out of your own way, and becoming the best version of YOU.

No perfection. No pretending to have it all together. Just honest conversations, practical tools, a little humor, and plenty of encouragement to help you navigate real life.

Because becoming your best self isn't about changing who you are. It's about learning to believe in who you can become.

Subscribe and join me for a little real talk, a fresh perspective, and the reminder you might need today.

Connect with me:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/realtalk_withrachael/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/RachaelRTowne/

Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@RachaelTowne

title: The Agency Value Model
author: Brian Kessman
description:
You changed how you price, but the economics haven’t changed. Clients still want more for less, procurement still benchmarks your rates, and now both expect AI to bring the price down again.


Pricing is where tension shows up first, but it is not where the work begins.


The Agency Value Model: Growth vs Scaling is a podcast for agency CEOs and CFOs who already know the model has to change and want to know how. Each episode, Brian Kessman talks with an agency leader who has redesigned the way their firm defines, packages, or prices its value. You’ll hear what worked, what didn’t, and how they’re scaling revenue without hiring more people or billing more hours. Then Brian closes with one thing you can take back to your own agency.

title: Ireland: Built for what's next
author: Reuters Plus
description:
'Ireland: Built for what's next' is a new three-part podcast series from Reuters Plus, produced for IDA Ireland, exploring why Ireland continues to attract global leaders across technology, life sciences, financial services and semiconductors. Hosted by Claire Brock, Reuters Plus, each episode brings together senior voices to share the latest insight on the forces shaping the future of business in Ireland. From cross-sector convergence and breakthrough innovation to the talent, partnerships and ecosystem driving long-term growth, tune in to hear how Ireland is building what's next. Don't miss a single episode.

Visit the Thomson Reuters Privacy Statement for information on our privacy and data protection practices.  

You may also visit megaphone.fm/adchoices to opt-out of targeted advertising.

title: Video Games Explainer: PC hardware, gaming tech, and computer history
author: Video Games Explainer
description: Welcome to Video Games Explainer, your ultimate audio guide to PC hardware, gaming tech, and computer history.  Whether you are planning your first custom PC build, researching GPU and CPU upgrades, or hunting for the best gaming laptop, we break down complex hardware specs into clear, actionable advice. From deep dives into graphics cards (Nvidia, AMD, Intel), processors, motherboards, RAM, and power supplies, to retrospectives on classic hardware wars and forgotten tech pioneers—we cover it all.  What you'll find here: • Clear breakdowns of PC components and hardware specs  • Gaming laptop guides, benchmarks, and display tech comparisons  • Tech retrospectives: CPU/GPU wars, legacy chipsets, and computing history  • Practical buying advice for budget, mid-range, and high-end gaming rigs  Follow the show to stay up to date on gaming tech, computer hardware essentials, and the history behind the machines we play on.

title: Durable Democracy
author: Peter Fasciano
description: Join Anne Bergen and others to discuss what we stand to lose if we do not work to keep our democracy durable, and speak truth to power.

title: Blind Label Cigar Podcast
author: Norm Farrar
description:
Welcome to the Blind Label Cigar Podcast.

The longer you're into cigars, the more things you end up keeping track of.

A new release you want to try. A review you meant to read. The name of a cigar somebody mentioned last week. Notes on something you smoked months ago. Then there are podcasts, newsletters, group chats and social feeds.

It gets scattered pretty quickly.

Blind Label Cigar was built to bring those pieces together and let you use them your way.

Keep up with industry news, reviews, new releases and straightforward cigar education. Join the members area to save cigars, build your own digital humidor, write your own reviews and keep track of what interests you.

Then stay connected however you want. Listen to the Blind Label Cigar Podcast. Read the newsletter. Join the conversation on WhatsApp. Follow us on social media. Or just use the website.

You don't have to use everything.

Maybe you come for the reviews. Maybe the humidor is what keeps you coming back. Maybe you never miss the podcast. The point is to give you one place to come back to for whatever part of cigar life interests you.

Give cigar lovers one place for the information, tools and conversations they are looking for, then let them decide how they want to use it.

So pull up a chair. Good cigars, great people, better together.

New episodes weekly. You've got to be 21 or older, and of legal smoking age where you live, to listen.

title: The Sunday Scaries with Bash Croft
author: Persephonica
description:
Sundays are terrifying. The weekend’s nearly over. Your screen time is humiliating. Fortunately, Bash Croft and his friends are on hand to wrap up the week, and make your Sunday suck that little bit less.


Each week, Bash is joined by special guests to catch-up on highlights from the past week, talk through their anxieties, and nominate any flops or slays.


Bash and his friends will also press play on the answerphone machine to advise on listeners’ problems from the week, dilemmas and personal wins, before finally ‘ditching the dread’ and looking forward (or not) to the week ahead.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: VoxTales
author: VoxTales
description: Long-form stories. Original fiction, first-person, surprising endings.

title: Look to Jesus — Come, Follow Me
author: Jage
description: Sometimes we all need some help just getting started. Come, Follow Me is meant for personal and family study, and nothing here replaces that — this is a stepping stone: use it instead of doing nothing, until you're studying on your own or with your family. Don't land here and park; use this as a hand up, then move on to the next level. Independent study by Michael Jage, a member of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. Not published, sponsored, endorsed, or affiliated with the Church; nothing here speaks for the Church. Official lesson: churchofjesuschrist.org

title: Ending Empire
author: Abel
description: A podcast to raise awareness about the world's most harmful entity, the US Empire, by cutting through propaganda.

title: Silence: An Audio Drama
author: Oakridge Original
description: Grace is seventeen, and something happened to her last Christmas that she can't remember. When the memories start coming back in fragments, she starts a podcast and invites the world to help her find the truth. Silence is an audio drama set in Accra, Ghana, about grief, family, faith and the courage to speak.

title: No Manual: Four Kids and Winging It
author: Vanessa
description: I'm Vanessa, mom of four: two by birth, two by guardianship. Nobody hands you an instruction manual when you become a parent, so I'm telling it like it actually is — the funny stuff, the hard stuff, raising kids two different ways, and winging it through all of it. Explicit and honest. Parenting: equal parts impossible, hilarious, and terrifying — and somehow still the best part of my life.

title: A Storytelling of Crows
author: maevegarnette
description:
I'm here to tell stories about the struggle of life, the sweet in the bittersweet, and the beautiful mystery of it all. There is magic here as well as advice from lessons learned. Thanks for listening!

For more stories and art, follow me at garnettestarling.com

title: News with Peter Podcast
author: Peter Flanagan
description:
Northern Ireland's biggest stories, explained. No jargon, no spin, just the news that matters.

title: Period Care & MRI Safety
author: RichardBlake
description:
Period Care & MRI Safety is an educational podcast series dedicated to answering everyday questions about menstrual hygiene, personal comfort, and medical procedures. The series helps listeners understand how different menstrual products work, how to prepare for healthcare appointments, and why following professional safety guidance matters.Each episode explores practical topics such as sanitary pads, tampons, menstrual cups, period underwear, product materials, hygiene routines, and common concerns about undergoing medical imaging while menstruating.

The aim is to replace uncertainty with clear, accessible information that helps listeners feel more confident when discussing menstrual health with healthcare professionals.One particularly useful topic is whether menstrual products need to be removed before an MRI. Listeners seeking additional information can consult Sanitation Towel’s guide, menstrual cup mri, which discusses MRI considerations for pads, tampons, menstrual cups, and period underwear, including circumstances in which product materials or imaging requirements may affect preparation.The series emphasises that MRI safety depends on more than whether an item appears metallic. Certain conductive materials can heat during scanning, while products inside the pelvic region may need to be removed to help produce clear images. Individual imaging centres may also have different preparation procedures.

The podcast is intended for a general audience, including people preparing for their first MRI, individuals managing their periods during medical appointments, and anyone seeking reliable menstrual hygiene information. Its objective is to encourage informed questions, responsible preparation, and open conversations about menstruation without unnecessary embarrassment or fear.By combining practical explanations with reminders to follow professional guidance, Period Care & MRI Safety aims to make medical appointments more comfortable and menstrual health information easier to understand.
